method: Independent direct opens of primary documentation, upstream code, tests, and issue pages. No downloaded code was executed and no full page copies were retained.
source_identity_note: Existing R01-R18 identifiers retain the same source identity and URLs as the investigator map. This critic map describes only entries independently checked here; R02, R08, and R14 were not reopened. C01 and C02 are new critic-only IDs, not aliases or replacements for any R ID.

sources.title: Web Annotation Data Model
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current canonical W3C TR; no software release
sources.locator: Abstract; sections 1.1-1.3; bodies, targets, SpecificResource, selectors, states
sources.observed_operation: Defines a portable annotation model with body, target, and optional specific resource/selector/state; says the data model does not prescribe a transport protocol.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Selector relevance depends on media type; the model does not define synchronization or selector migration across mutable layout versions.
sources.applicability: Supports export/interchange vocabulary, not collaborative layout merge or semantic reattachment.

sources.title: Loro JavaScript API Reference
sources.released_version_or_commit: Rolling current docs; not pinned to an immutable package release
sources.locator: LoroTree section; TreeID and deleted-node query; concurrent tree operation notes
sources.observed_operation: Documents TreeID-based access, a deleted-state query, automatic cycle prevention for concurrent moves, and fractional-index interleaving while preserving relative order.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: API-level tree identity and conflict behavior do not define product identity, comment lineage, or user intent.
sources.applicability: Supports the engine-versus-application identity distinction and ordering caveat.

sources.title: Loro Tree tutorial
sources.observed_operation: Tree diffs contain create, move, and delete events; events follow causality; a delete event covers the target subtree without child-specific delete events. Fractional indices may interleave.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Applications needing per-child deletion explanation must enumerate affected IDs or retain independent anchor records.
sources.applicability: Supports the app-level anchor map and ordering/grouping caveats.

sources.title: Loro shallow snapshots
sources.locator: Basic Usage; Content Redaction; Synchronization Limitations; Archive and Trim
sources.observed_operation: Describes exporting a shallow snapshot at a frontier to trim earlier history, with a deleted-sensitive-text example and typical size reduction.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Peers must be based after the shallow snapshot point to sync; retaining a full-history archive preserves data outside the trimmed active snapshot.
sources.applicability: Supports coupled retention, synchronization, archive, and privacy tradeoffs.

sources.title: Y.Doc API
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current API docs; exact package build not pinned by page
sources.observed_operation: Documents that setting doc.gc=false disables garbage collection so old content can be restored.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The inspected page does not specify the default; it should not be inferred from this source.
sources.applicability: Supports a conditional retention claim, not a complete application tombstone policy.

sources.title: Yjs internal model notes
sources.released_version_or_commit: Mutable main; immutable commit not identified in the inspected page
sources.observed_operation: States that Yjs deletion metadata does not retain when or which user deleted an item; when GC is enabled, deleted content is discarded and a lightweight GC struct retains removed length.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: This describes library metadata and conditional GC, not custom application fields.
sources.applicability: Supports keeping thread intent and policy-approved deletion explanation in app-level records.

sources.title: Automerge conflict documentation
sources.released_version_or_commit: Rolling current docs; no package build pinned by page
sources.locator: Conflict alternatives and operation ID ordering
sources.observed_operation: Concurrent writes to one property expose alternatives through conflict inspection; the displayed winner is ordered by operation ID rather than wall clock.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Ordinary property reads can hide alternatives unless the application inspects conflicts; deterministic selection is not semantic intent.
sources.applicability: Supports preserving conflict alternatives for anchor resolution.

sources.title: Automerge merge rules
sources.locator: Map merge rules and list merge rules
sources.observed_operation: The documented concurrent map delete/set rule keeps the concurrent set value; list operations refer to element IDs rather than raw numeric positions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: This is a CRDT merge rule, not a product-level restore decision for a deliberately deleted layout object.
sources.applicability: Supports the distinction between replica convergence and review intent.

sources.title: Automerge Repo storage
sources.released_version_or_commit: Rolling current Repo docs; not package-version pinned
sources.locator: Incremental storage, snapshot compaction, concurrent tabs
sources.observed_operation: Repo periodically combines stored incrementals into a snapshot; concurrent compaction removes only changes already incorporated by that snapshot.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Repo persistence behavior is distinct from Automerge core merge rules and application comment retention.
sources.applicability: Supports comparing storage tooling separately from user-visible history policy.

sources.title: Automerge glossary
sources.released_version_or_commit: Rolling current docs; not package-version pinned
sources.observed_operation: Defines history compaction as storing current state without full history and notes the compacted document may no longer sync with a replica that lacks a common ancestor.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Local compaction alone does not prove replicas or archives have purged prior content.

sources.title: Excalidraw reconcileElements implementation
sources.released_version_or_commit: Mutable master; immutable commit not identified in inspected page
sources.locator: shouldDiscardRemoteElement; reconcileElements; matching, append, order, and index-repair path
sources.observed_operation: Matches by ID; retains local when editing or newer; resolves equal versions by lower versionNonce; appends unmatched local elements; then orders and repairs indices.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Record-version reconciliation and absent-record handling are implementation-specific and do not encode comment intent.
sources.applicability: Supports the comparative example and makes the unreviewed test suite material to the brief.

sources.title: Excalidraw collaboration caller
sources.released_version_or_commit: Mutable master; immutable commit not identified in inspected page
sources.observed_operation: Caller gets scene elements including deleted entries, restores remote elements with local context, reconciles them, bumps versions, then applies the remote scene with captureUpdate NEVER.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Caller behavior uses Excalidraw conventions and does not define comment persistence or export.
sources.applicability: Supports the implementation/caller account in the investigator draft.

sources.title: Excalidraw issue 3795: import resets ID/version
sources.source_type: Closed public upstream issue linked to PR 3797
sources.released_version_or_commit: Opened 2021-07-04; issue closed with PR 3797; patch not inspected
sources.observed_operation: Issue reports importing an object without regenerating its ID or advancing its version, causing save/sync resolution problems.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Issue body is evidence of a reported regression, not a description of the exact patch or all current behavior.
sources.applicability: Supports an import/restore regression test; does not prove a current defect.

sources.title: Excalidraw issue 11933: remote index-healing/version report
sources.source_type: Open public issue report, not maintainer-confirmed at access
sources.released_version_or_commit: Opened 2026-08-22; reporter claims reproduction on package 0.18.1 and current master
sources.observed_operation: Reporter claims repeated remote index repair increments versions and can cause reconciliation to discard a later peer edit.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Not independently executed; report is not treated as a verified general defect.
sources.applicability: Supports a proposed integration-boundary regression check only.

sources.title: Excalidraw reconcileElements test suite
sources.released_version_or_commit: Mutable master; immutable commit not identified in inspected page
sources.locator: elements reconciliation suite; version selection cases, concurrent convergence, unique-index assertion, re-reconciliation, identical elements
sources.observed_operation: Tests version-based selection, stable unique indices, convergence across input order, and repeated reconciliation. The inspected suite does not model comment anchors or thread intent.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: These are Excalidraw implementation tests; they do not validate this proposed component or prove complete deletion behavior.
sources.applicability: Direct evidence for C1 and a baseline for comparing technical merge invariants with missing comment semantics.

sources.title: Loro issue 938: redo with recreated TreeID
sources.released_version_or_commit: Issue page; no package version or immutable commit identified in inspected page
sources.observed_operation: The issue describes redo recreating a LoroTree node with a new TreeID and losing associated text across separate undo steps.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Issue report was not executed or treated as maintainer-confirmed behavior.
sources.applicability: Supplemental caution that engine node identity and application object/comment identity need explicit restore semantics; it does not contradict the proposed independent application IDs.
